title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.21025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token. But that prediction passes through the unembedding matrix, or readout, which is itself still being learned during pretraining. We show that a model's hidden states can encode task information before its own readout expresses it, so timelines read from outputs conflate what the model encodes with what its readout expresses. To track the readout directly, we introduce parameter-trajectory crosscoding, which fits one sparse dictionary to every token's readout row at every checkpoint. Unlike crosscoders on activations, it needs only checkpoint weights. We use it to locate a narrow early window, 0.4-1.1% of the way through Pythia's pretraining, in which the readout reorganizes and WordNet word categories become decodable from its rows. By then, linear probes on the hidden states already decode

translated_title: 学会读出：语言模型预训练中的反嵌入动态
translated_abstract: 语言模型是在何时获得某种能力的？发展性研究通常通过追踪模型何时开始生成正确的词元来回答这个问题。但这一预测需要经过反嵌入矩阵（即读出层），而读出层本身在预训练过程中也仍在被学习。我们证明，模型的隐藏状态可以在其自身的读出层表达任务信息之前就已编码该信息，因此从输出中读取的时间线混淆了模型所编码的内容与读出层所表达的内容。为了直接追踪读出层，我们引入了参数轨迹交叉编码方法，该方法在每个检查点为每个词元的读出行拟合一个稀疏字典。与作用于激活值的交叉编码器不同，它只需要检查点的权重。我们利用该方法定位到一个狭窄的早期窗口——即Pythia预训练进程的0.4%–1.1%阶段——在此期间读出层发生重组，WordNet词类变得可以从其行中解码。到那时，对隐藏状态的线性探针已经能够解码
tldr: 提出参数轨迹交叉编码方法，仅利用检查点权重直接追踪语言模型预训练中读出层的动态，发现Pythia在预训练0.4%–1.1%的早期窗口内读出层发生重组，且隐藏状态在读出层表达之前就已编码任务信息。
en_tdlr: Proposes parameter-trajectory crosscoding, which uses only checkpoint weights to directly track readout dynamics during language model pretraining, revealing that Pythia's readout reorganizes within a narrow early window (0.4–1.1% of pretraining) and that hidden states encode task information before the readout expresses it.
